notes: Processed 50 groups from parts 26-30 into 50 rows (2 merges, 2 splits). Merged groups: 'sam altman backed bitcoin life' + 'meanwhile' (same $37.5M Meanwhile round, emitted under group_key 'meanwhile'); 'pidg' + 'dat bike' (same $26M Dat Bike Series B, emitted under 'dat bike'). Split groups into one row per round: 'healthleap' ($8M seed co-led by Sequoia and First Round + $30M Series A led by Hummingbird) and 'melius' ($5M seed led by General Catalyst + $20M Series A led by CRV). No round-up articles in these parts. 20 web lookups used (18 WebSearch, 2 successful WebFetch; 2 fetches failed with 403/429 and were retried on other pages): Zenzap (2), Healthleap, Pi Security (2), Mave, Nirva (2), Clockwork.io, Tian Keyu lab, Allara, Arboretum, Duvo, Benchmark Energy II, Aptadir, Altay, Gardens Interactive, Furientis. Lookup findings that could not be placed in investor fields because the candidate text has no verbatim span: Zenzap's $44M is reportedly $11M seed (2022) + $33M Series A (closed Aug 2025, announced Oct 2026), HQ Israel; Pi Security's $35M round was announced 2026-06-10 (Google News resurfaced it), led by Brightmind Partners and Third Point Ventures, HQ San Francisco; Nirva's newest round is reported by several outlets as a $25M pre-Series A (Lightspeed / South Park Commons) with $33M total, while TechCrunch's headline says $33M, so amount_usd is 25M with low confidence; Clockwork.io's $31M was led by Premji Invest, Wing Venture Capital and Seligman Ventures with NEA and e& Capital (one outlet calls it Series B, unconfirmed); Tian Keyu's world-model startup is still unnamed (China; 5Y Capital and IDG Capital reported); Allara's series was not disclosed (Fierce Healthcare says Index and GV led); Arboretum is Massachusetts-based (Boston vs Cambridge unresolved); Duvo (Prague) Series A was led by Balderton Capital with Index Ventures, Northzone and Credo Ventures, ~$32M; Aptadir (Milan) seed led by 4BIO Capital with EXTEND and CE-Ventures; Gardens Interactive (Los Angeles) Series B led by Lightspeed; Altay Therapeutics HQ San Francisco per most aggregators (PitchBook says San Carlos); Benchmark Energy II is Austin, TX. Round-type mapping notes: Mistlabs 'Pre-A' recorded as Seed; Paymob 'pre-Series C' and Allara/Clockwork/ZAP/WILDE/Meanwhile unlabelled rounds recorded as Venture - Unspecified; Dan-O's PE strategic investment recorded as Growth; Sensible Biotechnologies' $47M headline includes up to $20M non-dilutive Slovak/EU funding alongside the Series A. Currency conversions at EUR 1.12, CAD 0.72; Microbiotica uses the $48M stated in the title. Grants (Xcimer, Mojo Vision) kept with exclude_reason null and stage_bucket Other; the National Math Stars nonprofit NSF grant, defence contract modifications (L3Harris, Oshkosh), the Somerset Phase II real-estate construction loan and the Trustar Bankshares bank private placement are marked not-funding; Neighborhood Intelligence (registered direct offering) and Aquitaine Metals (TSXV) are public-company.
